name: cold_roofing_v1
hypothesis: Domestic roofers reply to the old-quotes offer at least as well as window installers, and the free-first-50 offer beats pay-per-booked-survey for them too. Same two offers as cold_offer_v1 so the trades can be compared like for like.
variable: offer line in the first email (subject, opener, the homeowner text, ask and follow-up 2 identical); trade compared against cold_offer_v1
decision_rule: After min_sent_per_arm first emails per arm: compare the trade's overall positive-reply rate with windows (cold_offer_v1). If roofing is not clearly worse, keep sending roofers and keep the better arm (>= 90% probability); if neither arm reaches 90%, keep the one with more booked calls.

arms.subject: last year's quotes
arms.body:
Hi,

Ever had a homeowner ring back months after a quote, ready to go?

Most don't. So I'd text the ones {company} quoted last year, from your name:

"Hi, it's {company}. We quoted for your roof a while back. Did you ever get that sorted?"

Anyone still keen goes in your diary. You only pay for surveys that get booked.

Worth a go?
